test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘PALACE’ is written as ‘ZKZOVX’ and ‘DEVINE’ is written as ‘VWREVM’. How will ‘SLOWLY’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, the alphabets and their positions are shown as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a827e903e52c199d8cea030f3655db9b02da63af4503920b2e34c4d18d2c5d.png] 

 

The logic here is: The reverse of each letter is taken. The 1st two letters interchange their positions, similarly next two letters do and so on,

‘PALACE’ is written as ‘ZKZOVX’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8110aad7f3a01da43fffc528957f6360aaf418e944fc106a92988a79e9711415.png] 

And,

‘DEVINE’ is written as ‘VWREVM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdfe4510bc735a23983c1ced545686dbfa360c0782dfdf57ca55392f1b3160bb.png] 

Similarly,

‘SLOWLY’ be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/759041b6ffda3570a82a05696984cec34f642fafb0245e0dc1a7ea45a91026ff.png] 

Hence, the code language is '__**OHDLBO**__' for the given word.
